simple: Privileged access management deployed entirely on your own infrastructure (formerly CyberArk PAM Self-Hosted, Core PAS, “the Vault”) — for isolated segments, critical infrastructure and regulatory requirements. A protected vault for passwords and SSH keys, automatic password rotation (CPM), isolation and recording of RDP, SSH, database and web console sessions (PSM) — the password never reaches the administrator’s computer, and an independent activity log survives even if the server’s logs are wiped. The Privileged Threat Analytics (PTA) module detects attacks on accounts: Golden Ticket, DCSync, Pass-the-Hash, use of unmanaged privileged accounts — and can trigger a password rotation. Licensed per user (subscription or perpetual); components are planned separately: vault high availability, number of concurrent PSM sessions, test environment, hardware appliances with HSM.
